verdict.rationale: v0 is itself a built-in AI agent: users delegate work in chat, and it plans, creates tasks, and connects databases as it builds. It also takes delegated fix tasks via 'Fix with v0', 'Fix Build', and 'Fix CI/Conflicts', reading logs and applying fixes, and a hands-on community report confirms shipping an app this way. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the agent's task planning and breakdown works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: v0 is an AI agent that helps anyone create real code and full-stack apps and agents.
v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds.
select Fix with v0 or Fix Build. v0 reads the relevant logs, diagnoses the failure, and applies a fix.
open the branch menu and select Fix Conflicts, Fix CI, or Fix CI + Conflicts.
Built a feature-rich internal app (time tracker w/ auth, roles, export) and had a working MVP in users' hands by Monday.
